title: Enhancer-targeted CRISPR-A rescues haploinsufficiency and mutant phenotypes in organoid models of autism
title_zh: 增强子靶向CRISPR-A在自闭症类器官模型中挽救单倍体不足和突变表型
abstract: Abstract Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a highly heritable condition with diverse clinical presentations. Approximately 15% of the genetic susceptibility of ASD is imparted by de novo haploinsufficient mutations of major effect. We mapped enhancers of two high-confidence autism genes, CHD8 and SCN2A , and used CRISPR-based gene activation targeting enhancers (eCRISPR-A) in human pluripotent stem cell (hPSC)-derived excitatory neurons and cerebral forebrain organoids to correct the effects of haploinsufficiency, taking advantage of the presence of a wild-type allele of each gene and endogenous gene regulation. Here we show that eCRISPR-A induced a sustained increase in CHD8 and SCN2A expression specifically in mutant neurons and cortical organoids, with rescue of gene expression levels and mutation-associated phenotypes, including gene expression and physiology. These data support gene activation via targeting enhancers of haploinsufficient genes as a therapeutic intervention in ASD and other neurodevelopmental disorders.
abstract_zh: 摘要 自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）是一种高度可遗传的疾病，表现形式多样。大约15%的ASD遗传易感性由重大效应的先天性单倍体不足突变所介导。我们绘制了两种高可靠性自闭症基因CHD8和SCN2A的增强子，并在人类多能干细胞（hPSC）衍生的兴奋性神经元和大脑前脑类器官中利用增强子靶向CRISPR激活（eCRISPR-A）纠正单倍体不足的影响，利用每个基因的野生型等位基因及其内源性基因调控的存在。这里我们表明，eCRISPR-A在突变神经元和皮层类器官中特异性诱导CHD8和SCN2A表达的持续增加，并挽救了基因表达水平及与突变相关的表型，包括基因表达和生理学。这些数据支持通过靶向单倍体不足基因的增强子进行基因激活作为ASD及其他神经发育障碍的治疗干预。
